eligible_scores: direct output work versus independent qubit-energy change
reason: Direct power is measured by an instrument independent of qubit tomography. However, the input-output law makes its conditional mean a function of the qubit state and frozen drive/coupling controls, so it adds no descriptor rank at mean level. No source-frozen map identifies it with the once-counted Tau body action; no closed holonomy or reusable raw archive is present.
decision: Primary independently instrumented energy-control candidate, not an information-novel Tau action axis; retain Naghiloo as trajectory control and do not combine carriers into a Tau certificate.
